## Home Manager

### programs\.xivlauncher\.enable

Whether to enable XIVLauncher\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
false
```



*Example:*

```nix
true
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/home/launcher\.nix](https://github.com/NekoDrone/xiv-flake/blob/main/modules/home/launcher.nix)

### programs\.xivlauncher\.game\.reshade\.presetMode



link: presets are read-only and fully managed (in-game changes won’t save)\.
copy: presets are seeded once and stay editable in-game\.



*Type:*
one of “link”, “copy”



*Default:*

```nix
"link"
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/home/reshade/presets\.nix](https://github.com/NekoDrone/xiv-flake/blob/main/modules/home/reshade/presets.nix)



### programs\.xivlauncher\.game\.reshade\.presets


*Declared by:*
 - [modules/home/reshade/presets\.nix](https://github.com/NekoDrone/xiv-flake/blob/main/modules/home/reshade/presets.nix)

### programs\.xivlauncher\.game\.reshade\.shaders

symlinked into ` reshade-shaders/Shaders/<installDir> ` and
` reshade-shaders/Textures/<installDir> ` in the game directory\.



*Type:*
list of (submodule)



*Default:*

```nix
[ ]
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/home/reshade/shaders\.nix](https://github.com/NekoDrone/xiv-flake/blob/main/modules/home/reshade/shaders.nix)



### programs\.xivlauncher\.game\.reshade\.shaders\.\*\.installDir

string

```nix
""
```
